player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleeya {player_id} long gem bilong Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Simbol bilong yu em '{symbol}'.
Go bilong yu em yu no inap kisim tri awewe (olsem, daun, o diagonal).
Sapos yu mekim tri awewe, yu lus.
Sampasim muv bilong yu olsem '[4]' long putim simbol bilong yu long sel 4.
Olsem Pleeya {player_id}, yu em '{symbol}' na enemy bilong yu em '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: I no orait long dispela pasin bilong i go. Yusim "[cell]".
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Insait bilong sel i no stret.

game_action.placed: Pleeya {player_id} putim simbol bilong em ({symbol}) long sel {cell}.

outcome.loss: Man {player_id} i lus sapos em inap pinisim wanpela lain!
outcome.draw: Em i wankain, na ol man bilong dispela hap i no lus.
